summary: Single-player title. 7 of 7 applicable boxes (.110 .123 .133 .143 .171 .184 .240) are PASS_SP: each was independently re-verified rendering the Thief Gold main menu fullscreen. .124 is BLOCKED (D3D on vcr-kmd), .186 and .243 are NA. The game was closed on all 7 boxes and every box is back at its desktop mode.
issues: Only the 2D main menu was verified. In-mission 3D rendering was not exercised, and .133 has a recipe warning about a possible mission-load hang.
THIEF.EXE ignores WM_CLOSE: lanparty kill had to use its forced step on all 7 boxes. No crash dialog was left and the desktop modes were restored.
lanparty.py kill takes the game as a positional argument. The documented '--game' flag is rejected.
